title: Le Blanc: none of these opinions satisfies; each labours under a notable difficulty
source_text: XXXIV. Porro quanquam omnium Doctorum istorum virorum suspiciam ingenium & eruditionem, in nulla tamen ex dictis sententiis acquiescere possum. Non enim omnem scrupulum eximunt. Nec eorum ulla est quae non insigni quadam difficultate laborare mihi videatur.
pass_a_gloss: XXXIV. Further although I look up to the genius and learning of all those Doctors, yet I cannot rest in any of the said opinions. For they do not remove every scruple. Nor is there any of them which does not seem to me to labour under some notable difficulty.
pass_b_english: For all my respect for the talent and learning of all these doctors, I cannot rest in any of the opinions described. They do not remove every doubt, and every one of them seems to me to struggle with some serious difficulty.
